name: regmeta
description: Tooling for working with Swedish administrative register microdata: register metadata search through the hosted catalog MCP server, a project's project_data.json (data order and inventory), local mock data, project setup, and research in a project whose results leave the data server only through the toolkit export gate.

interface.shortDescription: Register metadata, project data, mock data, project setup and research
interface.longDescription: Query Swedish register metadata (SCB, Socialstyrelsen and other holders) through the hosted catalog MCP server at reg-meta.vqv.uk, write a project's project_data.json (its data order and inventory), generate local mock data with reg-mock, set up a register research project folder, and work on research questions in it with results that leave the data server only through the toolkit export gate.
defaultPrompt: Find the definition and value codes for a Swedish register variable.
